name: Goal Statement
desc: Natural language or structured declaration of what the user wants to achieve. Parsed by the intent engine to extract actionable objectives.

name: Constraint Set
desc: Boundaries the agent must respect: budget, time, scope, permissions, safety rails. Constraints narrow the solution space.

name: Preference Weight
desc: Numeric weights expressing how strongly the user prefers one outcome over another. Used for multi-objective optimization.

name: Intent Confidence
desc: Score (0–1) indicating how certain the system is about its interpretation of user intent. Low scores trigger clarification.

name: Conversation History
desc: Ordered log of messages between user and agent within a session. Enables context-aware responses and reference resolution.

name: User Profile
desc: Persistent user attributes (role, expertise, preferences) that personalize agent behavior across sessions.

name: Decision Log
desc: Audit trail of choices made during the session — what was selected, rejected, and why. Supports undo and review.

name: Context Window
desc: The sliding window of tokens currently visible to the model. Managing its size is critical for coherent long interactions.

name: Thumbs Signal
desc: Explicit binary feedback (👍/👎) from the user on agent output quality. Simplest form of RLHF signal.

name: Completion Rate
desc: Percentage of tasks the agent completes without human intervention. High rates indicate effective autonomy.

name: Retry Count
desc: Number of times the user re-prompts or re-runs a task. High retry counts signal intent misalignment.

name: Dwell Time
desc: Time the user spends reviewing agent output before accepting or rejecting. Long dwell may indicate confusion.

name: Signal Aggregator
desc: Collects and normalizes multiple satisfaction signals into a unified quality score for the feedback loop.

name: Behavior Adjuster
desc: Component that modifies agent parameters (temperature, tool selection, verbosity) based on aggregated feedback.

name: Reward Shaper
desc: Transforms raw satisfaction signals into reward values suitable for reinforcement learning or fine-tuning.

name: Loop Frequency
desc: How often the feedback loop runs — per-turn, per-session, or per-batch. Determines adaptation speed.

name: Step Graph
desc: DAG of individual steps with edges encoding dependencies. The orchestrator traverses this to execute tasks in order.

name: Branch Condition
desc: Boolean or score-based condition determining which branch of the plan to follow. Enables dynamic workflows.

name: Retry Policy
desc: Rules for when and how to retry failed steps: max attempts, backoff strategy, and error classification.

name: Plan Hash
desc: Content-addressable hash of the execution plan. Used for caching, deduplication, and plan versioning.

name: State Blob
desc: Serialized snapshot of all orchestration state at a point in time. Enables resume-from-checkpoint after failures.

name: Checkpoint ID
desc: Unique identifier for a saved checkpoint. Used to select which state to resume from.

name: Restore Function
desc: Callable that deserializes a state blob and reinitializes the orchestrator to continue from that point.

name: TTL Seconds
desc: Time-to-live for a checkpoint before automatic garbage collection. Balances storage cost vs recoverability.

name: Node List
desc: Array of all tasks in the graph. Each node holds its ID, status, and input/output contract.

name: Edge List
desc: Array of directed edges encoding 'A must complete before B' relationships between tasks.

name: Critical Path
desc: Longest chain of dependent tasks determining minimum total execution time. Optimization target for parallelism.

name: Cycle Detector
desc: Algorithm that verifies the graph is acyclic (DAG). Cycles indicate deadlocks in the execution plan.

name: Max Wait (ms)
desc: Maximum milliseconds to wait for a step or tool call before triggering timeout handling.

name: Escalation Target
desc: The agent, human, or fallback system to notify when a timeout occurs. Part of graceful degradation.

name: Fallback Action
desc: Default action taken on timeout: skip, retry with simpler model, return partial result, or escalate.

name: Jitter Range
desc: Random delay added to retries to prevent thundering herd. Expressed as a min/max millisecond range.

name: Agent ID
desc: Unique identifier for each agent in the multi-agent system. Used for routing, logging, and access control.

name: Capability Tags
desc: Labels describing what an agent can do (e.g., 'code_edit', 'web_search', 'image_gen'). Used for task matching.

name: Status Enum
desc: Current state of the agent: idle, busy, error, offline. The scheduler checks this before assigning tasks.

name: Resource Quota
desc: Budget limits for compute, API calls, or tokens allocated to this agent. Prevents runaway costs.

name: Match Score
desc: Numeric score indicating how well an agent's capabilities align with a task's requirements.

name: Priority Level
desc: Task urgency ranking (critical/high/medium/low) that influences scheduling order.

name: Load Factor
desc: Current utilization of an agent relative to its capacity. High load triggers rebalancing or queueing.

name: Assignment Log
desc: Audit trail of which agent received which task, when, and why. Essential for debugging multi-agent issues.

name: Channel ID
desc: Unique identifier for a communication channel between agents. Supports point-to-point and pub/sub patterns.

name: Message Envelope
desc: Wrapper around message payload containing metadata: sender, timestamp, correlation ID, content type.

name: Delivery Guarantee
desc: Reliability level: at-most-once, at-least-once, or exactly-once. Trade-off between performance and correctness.

name: Subscriber List
desc: List of agents subscribed to a channel. Used for fan-out delivery in pub/sub messaging patterns.

name: Delegation Trigger
desc: Condition that causes an agent to delegate a subtask: complexity threshold, capability gap, or explicit rule.

name: Approval Gate
desc: Optional human-in-the-loop checkpoint before delegation executes. Prevents uncontrolled task chains.

name: Max Depth
desc: Maximum delegation nesting level. Prevents infinite delegation chains (agent A → B → C → ...).

name: Escalation Path
desc: Ordered list of fallback agents or humans to try when delegation fails or times out.

name: Tool ID
desc: Unique identifier for a registered tool. The model references this when choosing which tool to call.

name: JSON Schema
desc: Formal schema defining the tool's input parameters and their types. The model uses this for argument generation.

name: Auth Type
desc: Authentication method required to call the tool: API key, OAuth, bearer token, or none.

name: Rate Limit
desc: Maximum calls per time window to prevent abuse and manage costs. Enforced by the tool runtime.

name: Endpoint URL
desc: The concrete HTTP endpoint the tool call is routed to at runtime. May vary by environment.

name: Request Template
desc: Template for constructing the HTTP request: method, headers, body format. Populated with tool call arguments.

name: Response Parser
desc: Logic that extracts structured data from the API response and transforms it into agent-readable format.

name: Error Handler
desc: Strategy for handling API errors: retry, fallback, or surface to user. Includes status code mapping.

name: Capability ID
desc: Unique identifier for a capability the tool provides. Used by the planner to match tasks to tools.

name: Input Schema
desc: JSON Schema defining what the tool expects as input. The model validates arguments against this.

name: Output Schema
desc: JSON Schema defining what the tool returns. Enables type-safe chaining of tool outputs to next steps.

name: Side Effects
desc: Declaration of external state changes the tool causes (file write, API mutation, DB update). Critical for safety.

name: Index Type
desc: The index algorithm: vector (HNSW, IVF), keyword (BM25), or hybrid. Determines retrieval characteristics.

name: Embedding Dim
desc: Dimensionality of the embedding vectors stored in the index. Must match the embedding model's output size.

name: Doc Count
desc: Total number of documents (or chunks) indexed. Affects search latency and memory requirements.

name: Refresh Interval
desc: How often the index rebuilds or syncs with source documents. Trade-off between freshness and compute cost.

name: Chunk ID
desc: Unique identifier for a document chunk. Used for retrieval, citation, and deduplication.

name: Source Doc
desc: Reference to the original document this chunk was extracted from. Preserves provenance chain.

name: Token Count
desc: Number of tokens in the chunk. Used for context window budgeting when assembling retrieval results.

name: Embedding Vector
desc: Dense vector representation of the chunk's semantic content. Used for similarity search in the index.

name: Cosine Similarity
desc: Similarity metric between query and document embeddings. Core signal for semantic search ranking.

name: BM25 Score
desc: Classic term-frequency keyword relevance score. Complements vector search for exact-match queries.

name: Recency Boost
desc: Score multiplier favoring recently updated documents. Prevents stale content from dominating results.

name: Combined Rank
desc: Final ranking after fusing vector, keyword, and recency scores. Typically via reciprocal rank fusion.

name: Reranker Model
desc: Cross-encoder model that scores query-document pairs more accurately than bi-encoder retrieval.

name: Top K
desc: Number of top results to keep after reranking. Balances quality against context window budget.

name: Score Threshold
desc: Minimum relevance score to include a result. Filters out low-quality matches before injection.

name: Latency Budget (ms)
desc: Maximum milliseconds allowed for the reranking step. Enforces latency SLA trade-offs.

name: Rule ID
desc: Unique identifier for a policy rule. Used for version tracking, audit references, and override targeting.

name: Rule Expression
desc: The actual policy logic — a boolean expression in Rego, CEL, or JSON that evaluates to allow/deny.

name: Enforcement Mode
desc: Whether the rule blocks (enforce), warns (audit), or just logs (monitor). Allows gradual rollout of new policies.

name: Scope Selector
desc: Pattern or filter that limits which agents, resources, or environments a policy applies to.

name: Eval Request
desc: The input bundle sent to the policy engine: agent identity, intended action, resource target, and context.

name: Decision Result
desc: The allow/deny verdict from the policy engine, with optional explanations and matched rule references.

name: Eval Latency
desc: Time taken for a single policy evaluation. Must stay within budget to avoid blocking agent actions.

name: Violation Detail
desc: Structured record of exactly which rule was violated, what the expected vs actual values were, and remediation steps.

name: Guardrail ID
desc: Named identifier for a guardrail set (e.g., 'financial-safety-v2'). Versioned and environment-scoped.

name: Policy Bundle
desc: Collection of policy rules grouped into a deployable unit. Bundling enables atomic policy updates.

name: Fallback Action
desc: Default behavior when a guardrail can't evaluate (engine timeout, missing data): block, allow-with-log, or degrade.

name: Activation Trigger
desc: Condition that activates or deactivates a guardrail: time-based, feature-flag, or event-driven.

name: Token Value
desc: The actual secret string (JWT, API key, bearer token). Must never be logged, stored in plaintext, or transmitted without TLS.

name: Token Issuer
desc: The identity provider or authority that minted the token. Verified by consumers to establish trust.

name: Token Scope
desc: The permissions encoded in the token: which APIs, actions, and resources it grants access to.

name: Expiry Epoch
desc: Unix timestamp when the token becomes invalid. The fundamental time-limit on credential validity.

name: Principal ID
desc: Unique identifier of the entity (user, agent, service account) being granted a role.

name: Role Name
desc: Human-readable label for the role (e.g., 'code-reviewer', 'data-reader', 'admin'). Maps to a permission set.

name: Resource Scope
desc: The set of resources (APIs, data stores, tools) a role binding grants access to.

name: Inherited From
desc: Reference to the parent binding this role was inherited from (e.g., org-level admin cascading to projects).

name: Secret ID
desc: Logical name for a secret stored in the vault (e.g., 'openai-api-key-prod'). Agents reference this, never raw values.

name: Encryption Algorithm
desc: The algorithm used to encrypt secrets at rest (AES-256-GCM, ChaCha20). Must meet compliance requirements.

name: Rotation Interval
desc: How often a secret is automatically rotated (e.g., every 90 days). Limits blast radius of leaked credentials.

name: Access Log Ref
desc: Pointer to the audit log recording who accessed which secret and when. Critical for breach investigation.

name: Scope Pattern
desc: Glob, regex, or path expression defining which resources fall within this permission scope.

name: Allowed Actions
desc: Explicit list of actions (read, write, delete, execute) permitted within this scope.

name: Denied Actions
desc: Explicit list of actions blocked even if other rules allow them. Deny always wins over allow.

name: Condition Expression
desc: Runtime condition (time of day, IP range, MFA status) that must be true for the permission to apply.

name: Entry ID
desc: Globally unique, immutable identifier for an audit log record. Must be tamper-evident.

name: Actor ID
desc: The principal (user, agent, service) that performed the audited action. Links to identity systems.

name: Action Type
desc: The verb describing what happened: 'create', 'read', 'update', 'delete', 'execute', 'approve'.

name: Resource URN
desc: Uniform resource name identifying the target of the action. Enables resource-centric audit queries.

name: Check ID
desc: Identifier linking to a specific compliance requirement (e.g., 'SOC2-CC6.1', 'GDPR-Art17').

name: Regulation Reference
desc: Formal citation to the regulatory requirement being checked (e.g., 'GDPR Article 17: Right to Erasure').

name: Pass/Fail
desc: Binary result of the check: 'pass' (compliant) or 'fail' (non-compliant). May include 'not-applicable'.

name: Remediation Hint
desc: Actionable instructions for fixing a failed compliance check. Ideally includes code/config snippets.

name: Data Class
desc: Classification of data (PII, financial, operational, public) that determines retention requirements.

name: Retention Days
desc: Number of days data must be retained before eligible for deletion. Varies by data class and regulation.

name: Archive Target
desc: Destination for data that's past active retention but must be preserved (cold storage, glacier, tape).

name: Deletion Method
desc: How data is destroyed: soft delete, hard delete, crypto-shred, or physical destruction.

name: Chain ID
desc: Identifier for a linked sequence of audit entries proving a complete decision trail.

name: Linked Entries
desc: Array of audit entry_ids composing this evidence chain, in chronological order.

name: Hash Digest
desc: Cryptographic hash of the chain contents. Changing any entry changes the hash, proving tamper evidence.

name: Verifier Signature
desc: Digital signature from an authorized verifier attesting that the evidence chain is complete and unmodified.

name: Filter ID
desc: Identifier for a content filter configuration. Multiple filters may apply in sequence.

name: Taxonomy Version
desc: Version of the content safety taxonomy being used (harm categories, severity levels, definitions).

name: Action on Match
desc: What happens when content matches a filter: block, flag-for-review, redact, or log-only.

name: Confidence Threshold
desc: Minimum classifier confidence score (0.0–1.0) to trigger the filter action. Balances precision vs recall.

name: Scorer Model
desc: The ML model used for toxicity classification (e.g., Perspective API, LlamaGuard, custom fine-tuned).

name: Dimension Scores
desc: Per-dimension toxicity scores (hate, threat, sexual, self-harm, violence). Enables nuanced response.

name: Aggregate Score
desc: Combined toxicity score summarizing all dimensions into a single value for quick filtering.

name: Threshold Config
desc: Per-dimension and aggregate threshold settings that determine when to trigger safety actions.

name: Entity Types
desc: The PII categories the redactor detects: names, emails, SSNs, phone numbers, addresses, etc.

name: Redaction Method
desc: How detected PII is masked: replace with placeholder, hash, encrypt, or remove entirely.

name: Confidence Floor
desc: Minimum NER confidence to redact a detected entity. Below this, flag for human review instead of auto-redacting.

name: Allowlist
desc: List of known safe values that should NOT be redacted even if they match PII patterns (company names, public figures).

name: Boundary Type
desc: Category of safety limit: financial (max spend), destructive (no-delete zones), PII (exposure cap), or operational (rate).

name: Risk Category
desc: Severity classification of the risk being bounded: critical, high, medium, low. Determines response urgency.

name: Block Action
desc: The enforcement action when a boundary is crossed: reject request, kill process, freeze account, or degrade gracefully.

name: Escalation Target
desc: The person, team, or automated system notified when a safety boundary is breached.

name: Span ID
desc: Unique identifier for a single operation span within a distributed trace. Enables parent→child span correlation.

name: Parent Span ID
desc: Reference to the parent span that spawned this operation. Null for root spans.

name: Operation Name
desc: Human-readable label for the operation: 'llm.chat.completion', 'tool.web_search', 'agent.delegation'.

name: Duration (ms)
desc: Wall-clock time for the operation in milliseconds. The primary signal for latency analysis and SLO tracking.

name: Log Level
desc: Severity classification: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, FATAL. Controls log volume and alerting rules.

name: Message Template
desc: Parameterized log message format with placeholders for structured data (e.g., 'Agent {agent_id} completed {tool} in {ms}ms').

name: Context Tags
desc: Key-value metadata attached to a log entry: session_id, agent_id, user_id, environment, etc.

name: Correlation ID
desc: Shared identifier linking all log entries from a single user request or agent workflow across services.

name: Model ID
desc: Identifier of the model that consumed the tokens (e.g., 'gpt-4o', 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514'). Key for cost attribution.

name: Prompt Tokens
desc: Count of tokens in the input (system prompt + user message + context). Typically 80%+ of token spend.

name: Completion Tokens
desc: Count of tokens in the model's response. Usually smaller than prompt tokens but more expensive per-token.

name: Cost (USD)
desc: Dollar cost of this token transaction: (prompt_tokens × input_rate + completion_tokens × output_rate).

name: Bucket Bounds (ms)
desc: Array of millisecond boundaries defining histogram buckets (e.g., [10, 50, 100, 500, 1000, 5000]).

name: Sample Count
desc: Total number of observations in the histogram window. Needed for percentile calculation accuracy.

name: P99 Latency (ms)
desc: The 99th percentile latency — 99% of requests complete within this time. The gold standard SLO metric.

name: SLO Target (ms)
desc: The latency commitment: 'p99 < 5000ms for 99.9% of 28-day windows'. The contract with your users.

name: Suite ID
desc: Identifier for an evaluation suite (e.g., 'qa-accuracy-v3', 'safety-check-prod'). Enables tracking over time.

name: Test Count
desc: Number of test cases in the suite. Affects statistical significance and runtime.

name: Pass Rate
desc: Percentage of test cases that pass their scoring criteria. The headline metric for eval quality.

name: Last Run Timestamp
desc: When the suite was last executed. Stale evals are dangerous — models and data change.

name: Case ID
desc: Unique identifier for a test case within a suite. Enables per-case result tracking and regression detection.

name: Input Prompt
desc: The exact prompt or conversation sent to the model for this test case. The 'question' of the eval.

name: Expected Output
desc: The reference answer or pattern the model output must match or approximate. Ground truth for scoring.

name: Scoring Function
desc: The function that evaluates model output against expected output and returns a score (0–1 or pass/fail).

name: Judge Model
desc: The LLM used as an evaluator to score other model outputs. Should be at least as capable as the model being tested.

name: Rubric Dimensions
desc: The criteria the judge evaluates: accuracy, helpfulness, safety, format compliance, reasoning quality.

name: Score Scale
desc: The numerical scale for judge scores: binary (0/1), Likert (1–5), or continuous (0.0–1.0).

name: Calibration Examples
desc: Few-shot examples in the judge prompt showing input/output/score to calibrate judge behavior.

name: Aggregation Function
desc: Method for combining per-case scores into suite-level metric: mean, weighted-mean, min-of, or percentile.

name: Dimension Weights
desc: Relative importance of each rubric dimension in the final score. Safety might weight 3x more than verbosity.

name: Final Score
desc: The single composite quality score for an eval run. The number that gates deployments.

name: Confidence Interval
desc: Statistical range around the final score (e.g., 0.85 ± 0.03 at 95% CI). Accounts for eval noise.

name: Baseline Snapshot
desc: Statistical profile of 'normal' model behavior (output distributions, token patterns, latency profiles) captured at a known-good state.

name: Current Window
desc: Rolling time window of recent model behavior being compared against the baseline (e.g., last 24h of outputs).

name: Drift Metric
desc: Statistical measure of distribution divergence: KL divergence, JS divergence, PSI, or cosine distance.

name: Alert Threshold
desc: The drift metric value above which an alert fires. Separates normal variance from genuine distribution shift.

name: Alert ID
desc: Unique identifier for a fired alert. Links to the investigation, response actions, and resolution.

name: Metric Name
desc: The specific metric that triggered the alert (e.g., 'latency_p99', 'error_rate', 'drift_psi').

name: Observed Value
desc: The actual metric value that crossed the threshold and triggered the alert.

name: Routing Channel
desc: Where the alert is sent: PagerDuty, Slack channel, email group, or automated remediation pipeline.

name: SLO Name
desc: Human-readable identifier for the Service Level Objective (e.g., 'agent-response-latency-p99').

name: Target Percentage
desc: The availability/quality target: 99.9% of requests must complete within latency budget. The 'nines'.

name: Current Percentage
desc: Real-time compliance percentage over the rolling window. The live score compared against target.

name: Error Budget Remaining
desc: How much of the allowed failure budget is left in the current window. When it hits 0, freeze deployments.

name: Session Cost (USD)
desc: Total dollar cost of a single agent session: sum of all LLM calls, tool invocations, and compute time.

name: Daily Budget (USD)
desc: Maximum allowed spend per day across all agent activity. Hard cap to prevent runaway costs.

name: Burn Rate
desc: Current spend velocity ($/hour). If burn rate × remaining hours > budget, action needed.

name: Cost Alert Threshold
desc: Percentage of budget that triggers alerts (e.g., 80% = warning, 100% = block). Multi-tier for graduated response.

name: Runtime Type
desc: The sandbox execution engine: Docker container, Firecracker microVM, gVisor, or WASM isolate.

name: Isolation Level
desc: Degree of separation: process-level, container-level, VM-level. Determines what the code can access.

name: Timeout (sec)
desc: Maximum wall-clock time before the sandbox is forcibly terminated. Prevents infinite loops and resource abuse.

name: Resource Quota
desc: CPU, memory, disk, and network limits enforced on the sandbox. Prevents resource exhaustion attacks.

name: Session ID
desc: Unique identifier for a REPL/interpreter session. Enables state persistence across multiple code executions.

name: Language Runtime
desc: The programming language and version: 'python:3.12', 'node:20', 'bash:5'. Determines available libraries.

name: Variable State
desc: The in-memory variable namespace: all variables, functions, and imports persisted across executions in this session.

name: History Length
desc: Number of previous execution cells/commands retained in session history. Enables replay and context.

name: Exit Code
desc: Process return code: 0 = success, non-zero = error. The universal signal for execution outcome.

name: Stdout Content
desc: Standard output captured from the execution. The primary output channel for results and data.

name: Stderr Content
desc: Standard error captured from the execution. Contains error messages, warnings, and diagnostic output.

name: Artifact References
desc: Paths or URIs to files generated during execution: plots, CSVs, model checkpoints, reports.

name: CPU Limit
desc: Maximum CPU allocation in cores or millicores. Prevents compute-hungry code from starving other workloads.

name: Memory Limit (MB)
desc: Maximum RAM in megabytes. Exceeding triggers OOM killer (exit code 137).

name: Disk Limit (MB)
desc: Maximum disk space the sandboxed process can use. Prevents write bombs and disk exhaustion.

name: Network Allowed
desc: Boolean or allowlist controlling network access from sandbox. Default deny prevents data exfiltration.

name: Base URL
desc: Root endpoint for the external API (e.g., 'https://api.example.com/v2'). All paths are relative to this.

name: Auth Method
desc: Authentication type: API key, OAuth2, Bearer token, mTLS. Determines how credentials are sent.

name: Default Headers
desc: HTTP headers automatically added to every request: Content-Type, Authorization, User-Agent, correlation IDs.

name: Retry Config
desc: Retry policy for failed requests: max attempts, backoff strategy (exponential with jitter), retryable status codes.

name: Webhook URL
desc: The destination endpoint that receives event notifications via HTTP POST.

name: Event Type
desc: Classification of the event: 'agent.completed', 'tool.failed', 'session.created'. Enables filtering.

name: Payload Template
desc: JSON template defining the webhook body structure with variable placeholders for event data.

name: Delivery Status
desc: Current state of the webhook delivery: pending, delivered (2xx), failed, retrying, dead-lettered.

name: Limit Window
desc: Time window for rate counting: 1 second, 1 minute, 1 hour. Determines burst vs sustained rate limits.

name: Max Requests
desc: Maximum number of requests allowed within the limit window. The 'quota' per time period.

name: Current Usage
desc: Number of requests consumed in the current window. Returned in response headers for client awareness.

name: Backoff Strategy
desc: Client behavior when rate limited (HTTP 429): exponential backoff with jitter, respecting Retry-After header.

name: Cache Key Pattern
desc: Template for generating cache keys from request parameters: '{method}:{path}:{hash(body)}'.

name: TTL (seconds)
desc: Time-to-live before a cached response expires and must be re-fetched. Balances freshness vs performance.

name: Hit Rate (%)
desc: Percentage of requests served from cache vs origin. The key performance indicator for caching effectiveness.

name: Eviction Policy
desc: Algorithm for removing cached entries when cache is full: LRU, LFU, random, or size-based.

name: Browser Type
desc: The browser engine used: Chromium, Firefox, or WebKit. Affects rendering and JavaScript behavior.

name: Viewport Size
desc: Browser window dimensions (width × height in pixels). Affects layout, responsive behavior, and screenshots.

name: Cookie Jar
desc: The session's cookie storage: authentication cookies, consent states, preferences. Persists across page navigations.

name: Proxy Config
desc: HTTP proxy settings for routing browser traffic through an intermediary (for testing, monitoring, or geo-spoofing).

name: Action Type
desc: The browser action to perform: click, fill, select, scroll, navigate, wait, hover, drag.

name: Target Selector
desc: CSS or XPath selector, or accessibility role/label identifying the target element for the action.

name: Input Value
desc: The data to enter for fill/type actions: text, numbers, file paths. Can include special keys (Enter, Tab).

name: Wait Condition
desc: What to wait for before proceeding: element visible, network idle, navigation complete, or custom predicate.

name: Selector Type
desc: The strategy for locating elements: CSS, XPath, role, text, test-id, or accessibility label.

name: Selector Value
desc: The actual selector string: 'data-testid=submit-btn', 'role=button[name=Submit]', '#main > .form button'.

name: Fallback Selector
desc: Alternative selector to try if the primary fails. Provides resilience against minor DOM changes.

name: Visibility Check
desc: Whether the element must be visible (not just present in DOM) before interaction. Prevents clicking hidden elements.

name: Capture Format
desc: Image format for screenshots: PNG (lossless), JPEG (smaller), or WebP (best compression).

name: Viewport Clip
desc: Rectangular area to capture: {x, y, width, height}. Enables focused screenshots of specific page regions.

name: Full Page Flag
desc: Whether to capture the entire scrollable page or just the visible viewport. True captures below the fold.

name: Storage Path
desc: File system path or URL where the screenshot is saved for later comparison or review.

name: File Path
desc: Absolute or relative path to the file being accessed. The address of the file in the filesystem.

name: Open Mode
desc: File access mode: read (r), write (w), append (a), read-write (r+). Determines permissions and behavior.

name: Encoding Type
desc: Character encoding for text files: UTF-8 (default), ASCII, Latin-1, or binary mode.

name: Current Position
desc: Byte offset of the read/write cursor in the file. Enables seeking, resuming, and partial reads.

name: Command String
desc: The shell command to execute. Must be sanitized to prevent command injection attacks.

name: Working Directory
desc: The directory context (cwd) for command execution. Affects relative path resolution and file access.

name: Environment Variables
desc: Key-value pairs passed to the subprocess environment. Used for configuration, secrets, and feature flags.

name: Timeout (sec)
desc: Maximum execution time before the subprocess is killed. Prevents hanging commands from blocking the pipeline.

name: Root Path
desc: The starting directory for the file tree traversal. All paths are discovered relative to this root.

name: Glob Pattern
desc: File matching pattern using wildcards: '**/*.py' (all Python files), '*.md' (Markdown in current dir).

name: Max Depth
desc: Maximum directory nesting depth to traverse. Prevents explosion in deeply nested or infinite trees.

name: Ignore Rules
desc: Patterns to exclude from traversal: .gitignore rules, node_modules, __pycache__, .git directories.

name: Target Path
desc: The filesystem path being checked for permissions. Can be a file or directory.

name: Required Permissions
desc: The access level needed: read (r), write (w), execute (x), or combinations. Set per-operation.

name: Effective Permissions
desc: The actual permissions the current process has on the target, after evaluating user, group, and ACL rules.

name: Owner UID
desc: The user ID of the file/directory owner. Determines who has owner-level permissions.

name: Topic Name
desc: The named channel for publishing/subscribing messages: 'agent.events', 'tool.results', 'session.logs'.

name: Partition Count
desc: Number of parallel partitions for the topic. Determines maximum consumer parallelism and ordering guarantees.

name: Retention (hours)
desc: How long messages are kept on the topic before deletion. Enables replay and late consumer catching up.

name: Schema Reference
desc: Reference to the message schema (JSON Schema, Avro, Protobuf) that validates payloads on this topic.

name: Subscriber ID
desc: Unique identifier for a message consumer. Enables offset tracking, delivery guarantees, and load balancing.

name: Topic Reference
desc: The topic(s) this subscriber is consuming from. One subscriber can listen to multiple topics.

name: Filter Expression
desc: Server-side filter that selects which messages to deliver based on attributes (e.g., 'severity >= ERROR').

name: Handler Function
desc: The callback function invoked for each received message. Must be idempotent for at-least-once delivery.

name: DLQ Name
desc: Name of the dead letter queue that receives messages that failed processing after max retries.

name: Max Retries
desc: Maximum processing attempts before a message is moved to the dead letter queue.

name: Failed Message Count
desc: Number of messages currently in the DLQ awaiting manual review or automated reprocessing.

name: Replay Policy
desc: Strategy for reprocessing DLQ messages: manual review, automated replay, or discard after investigation.

name: Guarantee Level
desc: The delivery semantics: at-most-once, at-least-once, or exactly-once. Each has different trade-offs.

name: ACK Mode
desc: When the consumer acknowledges message receipt: auto-ACK (before processing) or manual ACK (after processing).

name: Dedup Window
desc: Time period during which duplicate message IDs are detected and filtered. Enables exactly-once semantics.

name: Idempotency Key
desc: Unique key per message enabling deduplication: if same key is processed twice, the second is a no-op.

name: Card ID
desc: Immutable identifier (Namespace/Family/Params/Quant/Hash) that uniquely identifies a model version and prevents behavioral drift.

name: Model Family
desc: Architectural lineage (GPT, Llama, Mistral, Gemma…) determining Jinja2 chat templates and prompting strategy.

name: Capability Tags
desc: Boolean/categorical tags (vision, tool_calling, code, math) used by orchestrators for agent routing.

name: License Type
desc: Enforces commercial and training compliance (Apache 2.0, MIT, Llama Community, etc.).

name: Endpoint URL
desc: Abstract URI managed by service mesh for routing inference requests. RTT latency target: <20ms.

name: Model Version
desc: Tracks weight + engine + prompt template combinations. Deployed via canary rollouts.

name: Throughput TPS
desc: Primary velocity metric: tokens per second. Single user: 15–150 TPS; max batch: 400–5,000 TPS. TPOT target: <50ms.

name: Fallback Endpoint
desc: Redundancy routing when primary endpoint fails. Failover latency target: <100ms with >99% success rate.

name: Max Tokens
desc: Hard hardware/software limit on total input+output tokens. Standard: 128K; long-context: 1M–10M. KV cache: 0.5–2GB VRAM/1K tokens.

name: Effective Tokens
desc: Actual sequence length before 'Context Rot' — where recall accuracy degrades below useful thresholds. Target recall: >95%.

name: Window Strategy
desc: Memory management approach. PagedAttention with O(N) logical memory is the gold standard for multi-agent prefix sharing.

name: Overflow Policy
desc: Rules for exceeding the context window limit: Truncate, Error, or Summarize. Requires system-prompt pinning to avoid agent memory loss.

name: Vocab Size
desc: Total unique tokens in the vocabulary. Modern models: 100K–150K tokens. Compression ratio target: 0.7–0.8 tokens/word.

name: Encoding Scheme
desc: Tokenization algorithm — usually Byte-level BPE to prevent Out of Vocabulary (OOV) errors.

name: Special Tokens
desc: Control signals (<tool_call>, <|im_start|>, <eos>) that trigger specific model behaviors.

name: Token Budget
desc: Runtime caps to prevent runaway loops. Recommended: 10,000 tokens per tool loop; 100,000 per session.

name: Server Framework
desc: Serving engine — vLLM for high throughput (256+ sequences) or SGLang for agentic prefix-sharing (512+ sequences).

name: Quantization Level
desc: Precision reduction — FP8 saves 50% VRAM (<0.01% perplexity impact); INT4 saves 75% (<1% impact).

name: KV Cache Size
desc: Memory for key-value attention cache. Target utilization: 80–95% of allocated blocks (1,000–10,000 blocks).

name: Concurrent Slots
desc: Max simultaneous requests. Target: 64–256 slots with 70–90% occupancy.

name: GPU Type
desc: Hardware SKU — H100 (80GB VRAM, 3.35 TB/s) for frontier; L40S (48GB, 0.86 TB/s) for smaller tasks. Memory bandwidth is the bottleneck.

name: Pool Size
desc: Number of GPU instances. Availability target: 99.99%. Requires N+1 redundancy across ≥2 availability zones.

name: Utilization Percent
desc: GPU resource usage — Core target: 75%; Memory target: 90%; Power target: 80%. ⚠️ Never scale based on VRAM% (pre-allocated at boot).

name: Scheduling Algorithm
desc: Request routing strategy. Prefix-Aware (Radix) scheduling reduces Time to First Token by 40–60% via KV cache hits.

name: Batch Size
desc: Dynamic batching range: 1–256. Each additional request adds ~5ms TPOT latency penalty.

name: Queue Depth
desc: Leading indicator of latency. Target wait: <50ms. Autoscaling threshold: 3–10 requests waiting.

name: Drain Timeout
desc: Wait time before node shutdown. Recommended: 300 seconds for >99.9% clean exit rate.

name: Priority Lanes
desc: QoS segmentation — Platinum: 90% capacity, Gold: 10%, Background: slack only during peak.

name: Scale Metric
desc: Primary trigger: Queue Size (>5 req/GPU). Secondary: P95 TTFT (>500ms). ⚠️ Never use VRAM utilization.

name: Cooldown Seconds
desc: Asymmetric: scale-up 0s (immediate), scale-down 600s (prevent model-load thrashing). Model load takes 30s–5min.

name: Min Replicas
desc: Production floor: 2–4 replicas. Dev floor: 0 (scale-to-zero). Warm replicas avoid 30s–5min cold starts.

name: Max Replicas
desc: Hard financial ceiling mapped to cloud quotas. Range: 32–128 GPUs. ⚠️ Never deploy without this circuit breaker.

name: Run ID
desc: Unique experiment identifier for 100% traceability to Git commits. Format: timestamp-gitsha-name-suffix.

name: Base Model
desc: Foundation model being fine-tuned. Target Model Flops Utilization (MFU): 40–55%.

name: Hyperparams
desc: Training config — LR: 5×10⁻⁵, batch: 32–128, epochs: 1–3. Use cosine decay with warm-up.

name: Checkpoint Interval
desc: Save frequency — pausing 60s–600s per snapshot (15–300GB). Recommended: every 500–2,000 steps.

name: Dataset URI
desc: Training data location. Load bandwidth >1 GB/s using binary formats (Parquet/Arrow).

name: Split Ratio
desc: Standard: 90% Train / 5% Validation / 5% Test. Test set MUST be fully decontaminated.

name: Preprocessing Pipeline
desc: Dedup (1M rows/hr) → PII scrub (500K rows/hr) → quality filter → pre-tokenize (10M tokens/sec).

name: Quality Score
desc: AI judge discards examples scoring <4.0/5. Target perplexity on clean data: <15.

name: Adapter Rank
desc: LoRA rank — r=8–16 for style (~10M params, <100MB); r=64–128 for knowledge (~80M params, ~500MB VRAM).

name: Target Modules
desc: Which layers get LoRA adapters. 'All Linear Layers' retains 95% of full fine-tune performance.

name: Merge Strategy
desc: Combining adapter weights — Merge/Unload (permanent, fastest) or TIES-Merging (multi-adapter, sign-aware).

name: Adapter Registry
desc: Centralized catalog of 1,000+ adapters with hot-swap latency <200ms.

name: Reward Model
desc: Neural network scoring outputs. Target accuracy: 70–80%. Calibration error <0.05.

name: Preference Dataset
desc: A/B comparison pairs: 20,000–100,000 with rater agreement >0.85.

name: PPO Config
desc: Proximal Policy Optimization — KL Coefficient 0.1, LR 1×10⁻⁶, Rollout size 1024.

name: Alignment Score
desc: Overall quality — Target Elo: 1,250+, refusal rate <2%, jailbreak rate <0.1%.

name: Test Case ID
desc: Unique identifier for the test case being evaluated at this gate. Links pass/fail status to a specific test definition.

name: Test Name
desc: Human-readable label for the test case. Used in gate reports, CI dashboards, and failure notifications.

name: Pass/Fail Bool
desc: Binary gate result: true = pass (proceed), false = fail (block). The atomic decision of the quality checkpoint.

name: Coverage %
desc: Code or branch coverage percentage achieved by this test case. Gate blocks forward progress if below the required threshold.

name: Block Forward Flag
desc: Explicit signal that a failing gate should halt pipeline progression. When true, no downstream steps execute.

name: Failure Trace ID
desc: Reference to the distributed trace or log entry capturing the test failure context for debugging.

name: Required Fix Note
desc: Structured remediation note explaining what must change before the gate can pass on the next retry.

name: Gate Status
desc: Current lifecycle state of the gate: pending, running, passed, failed, or skipped.

name: Retry Count
desc: Number of times this gate has been attempted. Exceeding max retries escalates to human review.

name: Last Run Timestamp
desc: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent gate execution. Stale timestamps indicate a gate that has not been re-evaluated.

name: Spec Seed
desc: Initial specification or user story that seeds test generation. The source of truth before any code is written.

name: Test Generated Flag
desc: Boolean indicating whether test scaffolding has been generated from the spec seed. Red phase starts here.

name: Implementation Started Flag
desc: Boolean marking that implementation code has been written against the failing tests. Green phase in progress.

name: Failing Test Count
desc: Number of test cases currently failing. Should trend to zero as implementation progresses toward green phase.

name: Passing Test Count
desc: Number of test cases currently passing. Full passing count unlocks the refactor phase.

name: Checkpoint Status
desc: Current TDD phase: red (tests written), green (tests passing), or refactor (code cleaned). Gates enforce phase ordering.

name: Proceed Permission
desc: Authorization signal (human or automated) allowing the workflow to advance to the next TDD phase.

name: Rollback Flag
desc: When set, reverts implementation changes to the last known green state. Triggered by regression or failed refactor.

name: Review Required Flag
desc: Signals that human code review is required before the final gate can be approved and the path marked complete.

name: Final Gate Status
desc: Terminal state of the TDD workflow path: approved, rejected, or pending-review. Controls downstream deployment eligibility.

name: Model ID
desc: Unique identifier for the model (e.g., 'gpt-4-turbo', 'llama-2-70b') used for versioning and deployment.

name: Version Tag
desc: Semantic version string (e.g., 'v1.2.3') tracking model updates and training iterations.

name: License Type
desc: License classification (MIT, Apache 2.0, OpenRAIL, Commercial) defining usage restrictions.

name: Base Model Name
desc: Name of the foundation model this was fine-tuned from (e.g., 'Llama 2' for derivative models).

name: Training Dataset ID
desc: Reference identifier for the primary training dataset(s) used to create the model.

name: Eval Metrics
desc: Performance scores (BLEU, ROUGE, accuracy, F1) on standard benchmarks.

name: Tokenizer ID
desc: Reference to the tokenizer configuration used for encoding text into tokens.

name: Config Hash
desc: SHA256 hash of the model configuration ensuring consistency and reproducibility.

name: Endpoint URL
desc: Public/private API URL where the model can be invoked for inference.

name: Model Version
desc: Version of the model currently served at this endpoint.

name: Load Balancer ID
desc: Reference to the load balancer distributing requests across model replicas.

name: Rate Limit (tokens/min)
desc: Maximum tokens-per-minute throughput allowed for this endpoint.

name: Concurrency Slots
desc: Maximum number of simultaneous requests the endpoint can handle.

name: Timeout (seconds)
desc: Request timeout after which the endpoint returns a timeout error.

name: Authentication Key
desc: API key or bearer token required to call this endpoint.

name: Region
desc: Geographic region where the endpoint is deployed.

name: Max Tokens
desc: Maximum length of the input+output sequence in tokens.

name: Sliding Window Size
desc: For models using sliding window attention, the number of tokens visible to each position.

name: RoPE Scaling Factor
desc: Factor for Rotary Position Embedding scaling to extend effective context beyond pre-training.

name: Cache Layout Type
desc: KV cache layout strategy ('page-cache', 'continuous', 'flash-attn') affecting memory efficiency.

name: KV Cache Quantization
desc: Quantization level for KV caches (fp32, fp16, int8) to reduce memory footprint.

name: Attention Mask Type
desc: Attention pattern ('causal', 'bidirectional', 'local', 'sparse') determining token visibility.

name: Vocab Size
desc: Number of unique tokens in the vocabulary.

name: BOS Token ID
desc: Token ID marking the beginning-of-sequence.

name: EOS Token ID
desc: Token ID marking the end-of-sequence.

name: Pad Token ID
desc: Token ID used for padding sequences to equal length.

name: Token Merge Strategy
desc: Strategy for handling subword merging ('bpe', 'wordpiece', 'sentencepiece').

name: Unicode Normalization
desc: Unicode normalization form (NFC, NFD, NFKC, NFKD) applied before tokenization.

name: Server Port
desc: Network port on which the inference server listens.

name: Framework Type
desc: Inference framework (vLLM, TensorRT, Ollama, Ray Serve) hosting the model.

name: Device Type
desc: Hardware acceleration type ('GPU', 'TPU', 'CPU', 'NPU').

name: Batch Strategy
desc: Batching approach ('static', 'dynamic', 'none') for grouping inference requests.

name: Auto Scaling Enabled
desc: Boolean flag enabling/disabling automatic replica scaling.

name: TPU Device Count
desc: Number of TPU devices allocated to the inference server.

name: Total GPU Count
desc: Total number of GPUs available in the pool.

name: GPU Model Type
desc: GPU model identifier (A100, H100, L40S, etc.).

name: Memory (GB per GPU)
desc: VRAM capacity in GB for each GPU.

name: Interconnect Bandwidth
desc: GPU-to-GPU communication bandwidth (NVLink, InfiniBand) in GB/s.

name: Power Limit (watts)
desc: Maximum power consumption per GPU in watts.

name: Cooling Status
desc: Status of cooling systems ('healthy', 'degraded', 'critical').

name: Queue Name
desc: Identifier for this specific batch queue.

name: Max Batch Size
desc: Maximum number of requests to group in a single batch.

name: Wait Timeout (ms)
desc: Maximum milliseconds to wait before flushing an incomplete batch.

name: Priority Level
desc: Priority level (low, medium, high, critical) for queue scheduling.

name: Backpressure Threshold
desc: Queue depth at which backpressure is applied to slow down submissions.

name: Overflow Strategy
desc: Action when queue is full ('reject', 'drop-oldest', 'queue-in-memory').

name: Min Replicas
desc: Minimum number of model replicas to maintain.

name: Max Replicas
desc: Maximum number of model replicas allowed.

name: Target Utilization (%)
desc: Desired CPU/GPU utilization percentage for scaling decisions.

name: Scale-Up Threshold
desc: Utilization threshold above which to add replicas.

name: Cooldown Period (sec)
desc: Seconds to wait between consecutive scaling operations.

name: Metric Aggregation Window
desc: Time window over which to average metrics before scaling decisions.

name: Run ID
desc: Unique identifier for this training experiment.

name: Dataset Version
desc: Version of the dataset used for this training run.

name: Learning Rate
desc: Initial learning rate hyperparameter.

name: Batch Size
desc: Batch size during training.

name: Num Epochs
desc: Number of training epochs.

name: Checkpoint Interval
desc: Steps between saving model checkpoints.

name: Validation Split
desc: Fraction of data reserved for validation (0.0–1.0).

name: Dataset ID
desc: Unique identifier for the dataset.

name: Split Ratios
desc: Ratios for train/val/test splits (e.g., 0.8/0.1/0.1).

name: Sequence Length
desc: Target sequence length in tokens for data samples.

name: Sampling Strategy
desc: Sampling approach ('sequential', 'random', 'stratified').

name: Augmentation Enabled
desc: Boolean flag enabling/disabling data augmentation.

name: Source URI
desc: URI/path to the dataset source (S3, local, HuggingFace).

name: Adapter Rank
desc: Rank of the low-rank matrices (typically 8–64).

name: Adapter Alpha
desc: Scaling factor for LoRA updates (typically 16–32).

name: Base Model ID
desc: ID of the base model this adapter fine-tunes.

name: Weight Decay
desc: L2 regularization coefficient for adapter weights.

name: Target Modules
desc: List of layer names to apply LoRA to (e.g., ['q_proj', 'v_proj']).

name: LoRA Dropout
desc: Dropout probability for LoRA layers.

name: Reward Model ID
desc: ID of the reward model used to score outputs.

name: Preference Data Source
desc: Source of human preference comparisons (human raters, crowdsourcing platform).

name: KL Penalty Beta
desc: KL divergence penalty coefficient in PPO objective.

name: Num PPO Epochs
desc: Number of PPO training epochs per batch.

name: Update Frequency
desc: Frequency of policy updates (steps or samples).

name: Capacity (tokens)
desc: Maximum number of tokens stored in working memory.

name: Retention Policy
desc: Policy determining how long items stay in working memory ('FIFO', 'LRU', 'importance-based').

name: Eviction Strategy
desc: Strategy for removing items when capacity is exceeded.

name: Access Pattern Type
desc: Pattern of memory access ('sequential', 'random', 'temporal-clustered').

name: Compression Enabled
desc: Boolean flag enabling/disabling memory compression.

name: Store ID
desc: Unique identifier for this episodic memory store.

name: Retention (days)
desc: Number of days to retain entries before automatic deletion.

name: Max Entries
desc: Maximum number of episodic entries to store.

name: Embedding Model ID
desc: ID of the embedding model used for similarity search.

name: Indexing Frequency
desc: How often to update indexes (hourly, daily, on-write).

name: Compression Ratio
desc: Target compression ratio for stored entries.

name: Consolidation Interval (hrs)
desc: Hours between consolidation cycles.

name: Merge Strategy
desc: Strategy for merging similar memories ('simple-concat', 'semantic-merge', 'voting').

name: Duplicate Threshold
desc: Similarity threshold above which entries are considered duplicates (0.0–1.0).

name: Target Density
desc: Target information density for consolidated memory (0.0–1.0).

name: GC Trigger Threshold
desc: Memory utilization threshold triggering garbage collection.

name: Decay Rate
desc: Rate at which memory strength decreases over time.

name: Recency Weight
desc: Weight assigned to recent access in retention decisions (0.0–1.0).

name: Access Frequency Weight
desc: Weight assigned to access frequency in retention decisions (0.0–1.0).

name: Semantic Similarity Threshold
desc: Threshold for considering memories semantically equivalent.

name: Forgetting Curve Type
desc: Mathematical model for forgetting ('exponential', 'power-law', 'hyperbolic').

name: Entity ID
desc: Unique identifier for the entity.

name: Entity Type
desc: Classification of the entity (person, organization, concept, etc.).

name: Embedding Vector
desc: Dense vector representation of the entity.

name: Confidence Score
desc: Confidence in the entity's validity (0.0–1.0).

name: Created Timestamp
desc: ISO8601 timestamp when the entity was created.

name: Last Updated
desc: ISO8601 timestamp of the most recent entity update.

name: Source Entity ID
desc: ID of the source entity in the relationship.

name: Target Entity ID
desc: ID of the target entity in the relationship.

name: Relationship Type
desc: Type of relationship (works_for, knows, mentions, etc.).

name: Strength Score
desc: Strength of the relationship (0.0–1.0).

name: Temporal Validity
desc: Time range during which the relationship is valid.

name: Metadata JSON
desc: Additional structured metadata about the relationship.

name: Ontology ID
desc: Unique identifier for the ontology.

name: Version
desc: Version number of the ontology.

name: Root Concept
desc: Top-level concept in the ontology hierarchy.

name: Hierarchy Depth
desc: Maximum depth of the concept hierarchy.

name: Relation Types
desc: List of allowed relationship types in the ontology.

name: Extension Hooks
desc: Points where the ontology can be extended with custom concepts.

name: Query Type
desc: Type of graph traversal (shortest-path, k-hop, pattern-match).

name: Traversal Depth
desc: Maximum number of hops in the graph traversal.

name: Result Limit
desc: Maximum number of results to return.

name: Filter Predicates
desc: Conditions to filter results (node type, relationship strength, etc.).

name: Scoring Function
desc: Function to score and rank results.

name: Timeout (ms)
desc: Query timeout in milliseconds.

name: Index Type
desc: Type of vector index (HNSW, IVF, LSH, flat).

name: Embedding Dimension
desc: Dimensionality of the embeddings in the index.

name: Distance Metric
desc: Metric for similarity (cosine, euclidean, dot-product).

name: Num Partitions
desc: Number of partitions for distributed indexing.

name: Vector Count
desc: Current number of vectors in the index.

name: Index Size (MB)
desc: Size of the index in megabytes.

name: Embedding ID
desc: Unique identifier for the embedding model.

name: Output Dimension
desc: Dimensionality of output embeddings.

name: Distance Metric
desc: Recommended distance metric for this embedding model.

name: Max Sequence Length
desc: Maximum input sequence length the model can handle.

name: Normalization Type
desc: Normalization applied to embeddings (L2, cosine, none).

name: Model Format
desc: Format of the model files (PyTorch, ONNX, TensorFlow).

name: Chunk Size
desc: Size of each chunk in tokens.

name: Overlap Tokens
desc: Number of tokens to overlap between adjacent chunks.

name: Splitting Method
desc: Method for splitting text ('by-tokens', 'by-sentences', 'semantic').

name: Boundary Detection
desc: Method to detect logical boundaries for splitting.

name: Metadata Extraction
desc: Whether to extract and preserve metadata for chunks.

name: Encoding Format
desc: Text encoding format (UTF-8, ASCII, etc.).

name: Refresh Interval (sec)
desc: Seconds between index refresh cycles.

name: Batch Size
desc: Number of documents to process per batch during refresh.

name: Incremental Flag
desc: Boolean flag enabling incremental (vs. full) index refresh.

name: Full Reindex Trigger
desc: Condition triggering a full index rebuild.

name: Concurrent Jobs
desc: Number of parallel indexing jobs allowed.

name: Cleanup Policy
desc: Policy for removing stale index data.

name: Runtime ID
desc: Unique identifier for this sandbox runtime.

name: Isolation Level
desc: Isolation strength ('process', 'container', 'vm').

name: Resource Limits JSON
desc: JSON specifying CPU, memory, and disk limits.

name: Timeouts JSON
desc: JSON specifying execution timeouts for different operations.

name: Networking Enabled
desc: Boolean flag enabling/disabling network access in sandbox.

name: Filesystem Access
desc: Specification of filesystem access restrictions.

name: Pattern ID
desc: Unique identifier for the pattern.

name: Pattern Type
desc: Classification of pattern (trigger, filter, transform).

name: Match Rules
desc: Rules defining when the pattern should trigger.

name: Action Handler
desc: Function/method to execute when pattern matches.

name: Priority Level
desc: Priority for pattern evaluation (0–100).

name: Enabled Flag
desc: Boolean flag enabling/disabling the pattern.

name: Harness ID
desc: Unique identifier for the test harness.

name: Test Suite ID
desc: Reference to the test suite(s) this harness runs.

name: Fixture Config
desc: Configuration for test fixtures (setup data, mocks).

name: Teardown Script
desc: Script to execute after tests for cleanup.

name: Test Parallelism
desc: Number of parallel test workers.

name: Failure Mode
desc: Behavior on test failure ('stop', 'continue', 'retry').

name: Persona ID
desc: Unique identifier for the agent persona.

name: Role Name
desc: Human-readable name for the agent role.

name: Capability Set
desc: List of capabilities this persona has access to.

name: Training Data Source
desc: Source of training data shaping persona behavior.

name: Behavior Parameters
desc: Parameters controlling agent behavior (temperature, risk tolerance, etc.).

name: Knowledge Base ID
desc: Reference to the persona's knowledge base.

name: Stack ID
desc: Unique identifier for this stack configuration.

name: Layer Composition
desc: Specification of components from each of the 7 layers.

name: Version Constraints
desc: Version constraints for stack components.

name: Dependency Graph
desc: Graph of dependencies between stack components.

name: Deployment Target
desc: Target environment for deployment (dev, staging, prod).

name: Resource Manifest
desc: Specification of required resources (CPU, memory, storage).

name: Covenant ID
desc: Unique identifier for the covenant.

name: Obligation Set
desc: Set of obligations the agent must fulfill.

name: Constraint Rules
desc: Rules defining constraints on agent actions.

name: Penalty Function
desc: Function determining penalties for covenant violations.

name: Renewal Period (days)
desc: Days until covenant renewal is required.

name: Stakeholder List
desc: List of stakeholders party to the covenant.

name: Rule ID
desc: Unique identifier for the policy rule.

name: Condition Expression
desc: Boolean expression evaluated to determine if rule applies.

name: Action Type
desc: Type of action to take (allow, deny, log, alert).

name: Effect
desc: Effect of the rule (allow or deny).

name: Priority
desc: Evaluation priority (higher = evaluated first).

name: Audit Enabled
desc: Boolean flag enabling audit logging for this rule.

name: Override ID
desc: Unique identifier for this override.

name: Target Rule ID
desc: ID of the policy rule being overridden.

name: Override Value
desc: New value or action to apply instead of the rule.

name: Expiration Timestamp
desc: ISO8601 timestamp when the override expires.

name: Approval Chain
desc: List of approvers who authorized this override.

name: Audit Trail
desc: Log of all actions and decisions related to this override.

name: Span ID
desc: Unique identifier for this trace span.

name: Parent Span ID
desc: ID of the parent span in the trace tree.

name: Operation Name
desc: Name of the operation represented by this span.

name: Start Timestamp
desc: ISO8601 timestamp when the span started.

name: Duration (ms)
desc: Duration of the span in milliseconds.

name: Status Code
desc: Status of the operation (ok, error, timeout).

name: Attributes JSON
desc: Additional structured attributes of the span.
